reviews.title: Barely adequate and totally unnecessary
reviews.text:
Greed has taken what was a pretty good app and stripped it of many valuable features that would be required of any app calling itself a hurricane tracker. 

Eg.  What good are track models without land mass in the display? You have to pay for a subscription for that and discussions about possible storm formations, maps, images that are just ripoffs from the national hurricane center.

You can get all the necessary information that the subscription offers costing $$ FOR FREE by doing a search for the NATIONAL HURRICANE CENTER and bookmark the URL for future reference.
